title: The Ebb session and label owner Leona Rupe
summary: He recalls doing another session for a label run by Leona Rupe, with Dick Surgeon as A&R man, and letting others pick the musicians.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you remember that lady? The lady who ran that label?

No, the one that I remember him introducing me to. It wasn't the lady. I learned the lady was in charge of the whole thing after I did it. But the lady was more nicer than who I thought I was doing the session for, because he was sitting there getting kicks. Who did the session? The guy that was supposed to be in charge of the session, the guy that Mr. Joe Asanto put in charge of the session, rather, I think his name was Dick Surgeon. Dick Surgeon? Yeah. Dick Surgeon. Where's that name called?
But the lady who owned the label was Art Roupes. I think her name was. Leah. Leona. Leah. Leah or Leona? It was Leona or Leah Roup. She was very famous. I think she was divorced from art at the time.
Seems like she had feelings anyway.
Yeah, well, yeah. She had probably been around the business being with art, you know, with specialty, you know. So she probably learned some of the ropes. Yeah, I'm sure.

Well, Dick didn't, you know. Yeah. Yeah. So she was at the session? Yeah, it was the session being done for her. Right. Which I thought was for Dick Surgeon, which wasn't. He was just there to boost me along to, for her. Oh, yeah.
He was just probably the A&R man, like they said. Yeah. Yeah. Did you have any, at that time, did you have any special people you used on your sessions?
